[{"id":11629951,"name":"Friendly Beast","trackName":"Friendly Beast","artistName":"Lac Belot","albumName":"ABRACADABRA!","duration":218.0,"instrumental":false,"hasWordSync":false,"plainLyrics":"Glora, as the Dauphine of France
Her sister as a Marie Antoinette
Who tied some flower in her hair
She said that about a year ago
When daddy went away to Mexico
It changed the color of her eyes
I didn't know if it was a lie
But I believed her then
We drove down by the sea
'Cos Glora liked to swim, but the water was cold
She helped me with my ice cream cone
Then leaned over to me and said:
"There's a monster living under my bed
Though it's fine, he's a friendly beast
He keeps me company
And lulls me to sleep"
"Step into the night, come over and see
What the fairy and me have made out of your teeth
A tiny ark to hold all your joys
Your favorite toys. Long out of harm's reach
The world is cruel, and needs to reform
So now a great storm lay the grounds for a restart
All aboard! Hear the ocean roar!
Come the great downpour! And drown every shoreline!"
Next night, around 4 or 5
I heard Glora cry in the other room
Went in and sat down by the bed
Petals still on her fuzzy head
Held her hand as if to say "I understand"
She smiled, and we stayed there 'till the sun rose","syncedLyrics":null,"lyricsfile":"version: '1.0'

plain: |-
  Glora, as the Dauphine of France
  Her sister as a Marie Antoinette
  Who tied some flower in her hair
  She said that about a year ago
  When daddy went away to Mexico
  It changed the color of her eyes
  I didn't know if it was a lie
  But I believed her then
  We drove down by the sea
  'Cos Glora liked to swim, but the water was cold
  She helped me with my ice cream cone
  Then leaned over to me and said:
  "There's a monster living under my bed
  Though it's fine, he's a friendly beast
  He keeps me company
  And lulls me to sleep"
  "Step into the night, come over and see
  What the fairy and me have made out of your teeth
  A tiny ark to hold all your joys
  Your favorite toys. Long out of harm's reach
  The world is cruel, and needs to reform
  So now a great storm lay the grounds for a restart
  All aboard! Hear the ocean roar!
  Come the great downpour! And drown every shoreline!"
  Next night, around 4 or 5
  I heard Glora cry in the other room
  Went in and sat down by the bed
  Petals still on her fuzzy head
  Held her hand as if to say "I understand"
  She smiled, and we stayed there 'till the sun rose
"}]
